E1.evidence: PR #285 (davetcoleman) quotes the runtime log: "Deprecation warning: parameter 'allowed_execution_duration_scaling' moved into namespace 'trajectory_execution'. Please, adjust file trajectory_execution.launch.xml!"; the fix was merged by the maintainer ("+1...Thanks for the contribution....merging.").

E2.evidence: MoveIt's TrajectoryExecutionManager (package moveit_ros_planning, loaded in the move_group node) moved the parameters it reads from ~allowed_execution_duration_scaling / ~allowed_goal_duration_margin into namespace ~trajectory_execution (MoveIt PR #72, merge 988ad5b7 on kinetic-devel, cherry-picked to indigo-devel as 47b1b2d); ur5_moveit_config's launch file still set the old names. A provider renaming a parameter that the consumer must follow is an interface change even though the consumer's fix is in a launch file.

E3.evidence: UPGRADE: the provider (MoveIt, separately released) runs at a revision newer than the one the UR launch files were written against; the launch file still names the parameters as they existed before the move. Reporter: "It is tested on Indigo, so necessary for both."

E4.evidence: PR #285 body: "Fixes warning:" followed by the two deprecation warnings from ros.moveit_ros_planning.trajectory_execution_manager.

resolution.evidence: PR #285 "Fix Deprecated warning in MoveIt: parameter moved into namespace" merged 2017-01-05 (merge 778c1ac); author states "It is tested on Indigo" but no MoveIt revision or post-fix log is given.

notes: The same fix is applied to ur3_moveit_config and ur10_moveit_config (same compositions with MoveIt); ur5_moveit_config is specified as the representative consumer. Parameter sides: the node that reads/declares the parameter (moveit_ros_planning's TrajectoryExecutionManager inside move_group) is recorded as provides, the package whose launch file sets it as consumes; names are resolved under /move_group because move_group.launch includes trajectory_execution.launch.xml with ns="move_group". Upstream MoveIt history: PR #68 (gavanderhoorn, MSA templates) moved the params in generated configs; PR #72 (wkentaro) made TrajectoryExecutionManager read them under ~trajectory_execution via DynamicReconfigure and kept reading the old location with the warning ("TODO: Reading from old param location should be removed in L-turtle."). consumer_built_against.broken is the indigo-devel revision immediately before the cherry-pick (c185888, which still reads getParam("allowed_execution_duration_scaling") at top level); resolved is the Indigo MoveIt the fix was tested on (only the distro is stated, so the branch head on that date is used). Code-level observation not stated in the sources: in both the pre- and post-move provider the DynamicReconfigure server under ~/trajectory_execution is created after the top-level read and its callback sets allowed_execution_duration_scaling, so a value set only at the old location may be overridden by the dynamic-reconfigure default; the sources document only the warning. Packet hash 778c1acda6dc3e194b50328259936c3f058bcb7 is a prefix of merge commit 778c1acda6dc3e194b50328259936c3f058bcb76.
